Subject: Final-mile capacity clearance: mission-control hold request for Helio Systems

Team —

Late-stage ask from Helio (HL-2029-482). They want a firm runway for a production rollout window starting 2029-08-05 for a multimodal inference workload (1.3B and 13B model variants). Summary:
- Target qps: 120 sustained, spiky up to 350 for 2–3 hours/day during training-fine-tune windows.
- Expected steady-state token throughput: ~1.5T tokens/month.
- Preferred region: us-west.

Request:
1) Quick availability snapshot for Dedicated pool (a 12xA100-equivalent baseline + canary slice of 2xA100-equivalent).
2) Proposal for a soft hold (no billing yet) on the required capacity for a 3-week window beginning 2029-07-15 to protect runway while legal/PO is finalized.
3) Fallback options (smaller quantized variants + burst to hosted) and a brief note on impact to latency/SLAs.

I've attached the latest SOW draft (MOP-Helio-final-sow.pdf) with model mix and expected ramp plan. This is a high-probability close — procurement told Karthik they'll aim to sign by 2029-07-10 if capacity is visible.

Can you confirm availability and whether we can put a soft hold (ops-friendly label: "mission-control-soft-hold-HL482")? If there are conflicting commitments in that window, list them and proposed mitigations.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

> Team —
> 
> Late-stage ask from Helio (HL-2029-482)...

Jonas — quick inventory check below. Attached is a raw extract (fleet-availability-20290625.csv) with per-pod counts and blackout windows.

Short answer: we can satisfy the baseline and the canary slice in us-west, but with caveats. Current status: 
- Us-west Dedicated pool: 28 A100-equivalent slots free across two pods (pod-3 and pod-7) as of 2029-06-25 10:45 PDT.
- Reserve commitments: 8 slots are already soft-allocated to an internal pre-prod test for another customer from 2029-07-12 to 2029-07-18 (can be shifted if we approve).
- Maintenance windows: pod-7 has a patch window tentatively scheduled 2029-07-16 02:00–06:00 UTC (can be rescheduled with 72h notice).

Recommendation:
1) Create the mission-control-soft-hold-HL482 soft hold for 12 slots + 2 canary slots from 2029-07-15 through 2029-08-05 (soft hold flag only, no billing). That aligns with their ask and gives 3 weeks of runway.
2) Pre-authorize reschedule of the pod-7 maintenance (ops to coordinate) if Helio needs uninterrupted SLA for the first week of rollout.
3) Plan for quantized fallback: we can route burst traffic to hosted-capacity pool (higher per-token cost, slight latency variance) — ops to publish estimated latency delta (+20–45ms median).

Risks/notes:
- If the internal pre-prod test (8 slots) is not movable, we would need to split Helio across two pods which adds cross-pod KV-cache penalties at high request rates.
- We should stamp a secondary fallback: pre-approve a short-term burst credit to use hosted fallback for 72h in worst-case.

I'll stand up a brief Ops runbook afterwards if you want the exact commands to mark the soft hold and scheduling notes.

— Ben

Redwood Inference
